text: **Hint 1:** Consider how L1 and L2 regularization differ in their approach to penalizing model complexity. L1 regularization (Lasso) tends to produce sparse models by driving some coefficients to zero, while L2 regularization (Ridge) tends to shrink coefficients evenly.\n\n**Hint 2:** Think about how the choice of the lambda hyperparameter affects the model's performance. The optimal lambda for L1 regularization might not be the same as for L2 regularization, as they handle the trade-off between bias and variance differently.
